name: Greeting
overview: Scripture reveals that a proper greeting reflects the recognition of God's sovereign gifts and the peace He brings to humanity. Isaiah 9:6 highlights the birth of the Messiah, whose names emphasize His divine authority and peace, setting the foundation for how believers approach one another. Luke 2:14 connects greeting with proclaiming glory to God and extending peace and goodwill toward others, underscoring the Christ-centered nature of our interactions. James 1:17 reminds us that every good and perfect gift, including the peace we share in greetings, comes from the unchanging Father, encouraging believers to greet one another with gratitude and reverence for God’s provision.
